verdict_text:
YES

The script casts exactly the 48 projection matrices matched by an anchored full-match regex, drops only the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` buffers, leaves every other tensor float32 with unchanged values and unchanged names, asserts all four required checks before writing, and writes to `out/T3` with a 67,108,864-byte shard budget. Correctness of the sharded layout and the index file name depends on the imported `save_sharded_safetensors` helper in `_ckpt`, which is not shown, so that part cannot be verified from this artifact alone.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
